text.p: It is designed for the real operating conditions of Nigeria and other African jurisdictions, not just for idealised software demos.

tr.td: Cases move across ministries, regulators, and state agencies with weak visibility and slow escalation.
One case record tracks handoffs, deadlines, queues, and supervisor action paths.
Approvals often sit apart from parcel, title, and field context, making decisions slower and riskier.
Permit, parcel, evidence, and legal workflow context stay connected.
Field teams still work where connectivity is unreliable and evidence must travel securely.
Offline cache, replay, secure local access, and field continuity are built in.
Records are harder to verify externally and more vulnerable to confusion over changes or custody.
Signed audit packages, verification workflows, and custody timelines protect integrity.
Government, builders, NGOs, and citizens rarely see tailored views of the same workflow.
Role-based workflows and stakeholder dashboards align incentives without fragmenting data.
